This is a fantasy SHAPE CREATURE, not a human, NOT an animal. Absolutely NO animal ears, tails, snout, fur, paws, beak, wings or animal costume. Use bold thick consistent dark chocolate outlines, large memorable graphic silhouette, tiny simple mitten hands and stubby feet, wildly expressive asymmetrical eyes, brows and mouth. Strong comic character acting, charming toy-like proportions. Flat saturated candy colors, only 3-4 main color blocks, NO gradients, texture, watercolor, realistic lighting or 3D rendering. Make personality readable through body shape and pose rather than clothing. A compact indigo rounded RECTANGLE being, angular flat-top silhouette with one chamfered corner, mint accent stripe. Upright composed stance, tiny rectangular feet. Strategic quiet mastermind, endearing perfectionist. No glasses required.
